story.region: A research ship off the Irish coast, 3:33 AM
story.title: The Glass Eye in the Deep Water

narrator.persona: a marine biologist reviewing audio logs three years later

sentences.text: Three slow thuds against the steel hull, repeated until the rivets groaned.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: My partner went down to check the wet well and never came back up.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I called his name into the radio, waiting for an answer.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: I am right here by the hatch.
sentences.speaker: mimic

sentences.text: Instead of my friend, a small silver coin sat on the wet deck, and the black sea began to rise like oil.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A giant floating bloodshot eyeball with a toothed mouth and trailing nerves crested the black water.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you have kept that silver coin?
sentences.speaker: narrator
